ash_merchant.title: A Cart in the Ash
ash_merchant.description: A covered cart waits where the hedgerow thins. The carter lifts a lantern and spreads a few goods across the tailgate.

ember_shrine.title: A Warm Shrine
ember_shrine.description: A small brick shrine stands beside the path, its bowl still holding clean water. Someone has left a handful of wildflowers in the ash.
